{{Top|leg}}
The '''advanced gravity generator''' was a more forceful version of the basic [[Gravity generator/Legends|gravity generator]]. The use of an unregulated energy governor in this device resulted in the creation of a powerful gravity swell that caused concern over harmful environmental effects. Subsequently, the use of this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utility item was discouraged.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
